title: ODOT Crash Data - 2021 - aggregate summary by area
text:
Aggregate crash summary by area - ODOT Crash Data - 2021 (2021).
- Delaware County: 3,433 crashes (5: 2,417, 3: 493, 4: 434, 2: 80, 1: 9).
- Fairfield County: 2,798 crashes (5: 2,032, 3: 368, 4: 286, 2: 95, 1: 17).
- Franklin County: 22,746 crashes (5: 14,520, 3: 4,617, 4: 2,844, 2: 647, 1: 118).
- Knox County: 1,115 crashes (5: 861, 3: 163, 4: 58, 2: 28, 1: 5).
- Licking County: 3,696 crashes (5: 2,717, 3: 507, 4: 339, 2: 109, 1: 24).
- Madison County: 986 crashes (5: 674, 3: 158, 4: 107, 2: 45, 1: 2).
- Morrow County: 845 crashes (5: 606, 3: 167, 4: 35, 2: 30, 1: 7).
- Pickaway County: 1,290 crashes (5: 925, 3: 192, 4: 121, 2: 42, 1: 10).
- Union County: 1,288 crashes (5: 980, 3: 147, 4: 123, 2: 33, 1: 5).
- Ohio statewide (all counties; NOT a Central Ohio figure): 269,674 crashes (5: 198,653, 3: 35,169, 4: 28,203, 2: 6,405, 1: 1,244).
Severity is shown as the layer's raw CRASH_SEVERITY_CD codes, which the layer publishes no lookup for; they are not decoded here. Computed on 2026-11-02 by counting records in the ArcGIS layer 'ODOT Crash Data - 2021' grouped by COUNTY_CD, CRASH_YR, CRASH_SEVERITY_CD. Source: https://tims.dot.state.oh.us/ags/rest/services/Safety/2021_Crash_Locations/MapServer/0
caveats: Aggregate counts only, computed server-side; individual crash records are not loaded in this knowledge base.
Severity values are the layer's raw codes (CRASH_SEVERITY_CD); no coded-value domain was published to decode them.
